content: [![Discord link to the "LopyMine's Project" discord server](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d9796c521a3261b9a7e4c3eb6b1c3d2dfe4c112.png)](https://discord.gg/NZzxdkrV4s) [![CurseForge Link-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e867d37a2f6ad224258b75aacf6477e777427717.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/particle-effects) [![Github Link-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae65154a7b076cd508f14975a27d1e75e3449a1d.png)](https://github.com/LopyMine/particle-effects) [![Modrinth Link-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9c43eaea7fc523285ae0981829b84e206672b48.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-effects) ## 💬 描述 Particle Effects 是一款轻量级的视觉客户端模组，为原版《我的世界》中的每一种状态效果都添加了独特的纹理粒子！同时也完美兼容多人游戏 ^^ ## ✨ 粒子展示 以下是每种效果对应的独特粒子预览： ## 🌟 资源包 此外，社区还提供了一些资源包，可对原版模组中的粒子外观进行微调。 1) [zed1ker 的粒子更新](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/particles-updated) 2) [Timofeii7547 的粒子更新](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/particle-effects-updated-particles) 3) [Dezert3 的 Bare Bones x Particle Effects](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/barebones-x-particle-effects)
